title: Whispers in the Smoke
description: Step into the glittering 1920s at an exclusive speakeasy where jazz fills the air and danger lurks behind every velvet curtain. When the club owner is murdered during a lavish party, secrets, bootlegging, and forbidden romances explode in this night of glamour and deception.
core_plot: During a high-stakes poker game in the back room, speakeasy owner Vincent 'Vinny' Russo is shot. A valuable shipment of illegal whiskey and cash disappears.
motive_summary: Control of the speakeasy, romantic betrayal, and bootlegging rivalries.
twist_ending: The missing whiskey shipment was poisoned. Vinny was about to expose a rival gang’s deadly plan, saving many lives.

owner.guilty: One of them was trying to take over my club. I had to protect what was mine.
owner.innocent: I was hosting guests in the main room most of the night.

singer.guilty: Vinny was going to expose my past and ruin my career in this town.
singer.innocent: I was performing on stage for most of the evening.

bootlegger.guilty: Vinny owed me a large sum and refused to pay what he owed.
bootlegger.innocent: I was delivering a shipment outside during the time of the murder.

socialite.guilty: Vinny knew about my gambling debts and threatened to expose me.
socialite.innocent: I was dancing and socializing in the main room all night.

detective.guilty: Vinny had evidence that could ruin my career and send me to prison.
detective.innocent: I was there undercover investigating the club.

bartender.guilty: Vinny found out I was working for a rival gang.
bartender.innocent: I was busy serving drinks behind the bar the entire night.

clues.clue_text: A monogrammed silver flask with strong sedative residue and fresh fingerprints.
clues.importance: Shows the victim was drugged before being shot.

clues.clue_text: A torn gambling IOU for a huge sum with the initials 'J'.
A broken pearl necklace strand and gunpowder residue on a discarded white glove.
clues.importance: Points to someone wearing formal evening wear.

accusation_phase: It’s time for accusations! We’ll go around one by one. State your character name clearly and tell us who you believe is the murderer and why.
reveal_phase: The murderer was… [Murderer Name]! Will the accused please stand and read your full confession to the group?
